comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector terminal; record aligns two pulley faces by repositioning a motor with a straightedge.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimeter latch access and coupled tool-wire pull versus planar slide/yaw adjustment and straightedge-based alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one terminal out with adjacent components intact; exact force/damage thresholds are missing. Record scores angular/parallel misalignment, continuous base contact, fixed center distance, stability, and hands-off state.
comparison.reason: Both need alignment, but alignment is only preparatory in the candidate; the tested abilities and final states differ.
